exposure: pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease
Pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease (PAH-CHD)
finding: The outcome of pregnancy in women with PAH-CHD was better than previously reported, with only 5% maternal mortality in this cohort.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 67% of pregnancies, of which 10 were emergency for obstetrical reasons.
